description: A script for computing and collecting interface information from IDL files, used in code generation for web platform components.

classes.name: IdlBadFilenameError
classes.description: Exception raised when an IDL filename does not match the interface name in the file.

classes.name: InterfaceInfoCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting interface information from IDL files, including handling partial interfaces, enums, typedefs, and union types.

methods.name: collect_info
methods.description: Reads an IDL file and gathers data needed for code generation, including unforgeable attributes, union types, enums, and interface relationships.

methods.name: get_info_as_dict
methods.description: Returns collected interface info as a dictionary.

methods.name: get_component_info_as_dict
methods.description: Returns component-wide info such as callback functions, enums, typedefs, and union types.
